messages:
tessa: Quick handheld pass on the console: on narrow widths the left nav eats into the table and you get a horizontal scroll. Posting a short vid.
omar: Reproduced on iPhone 8 emulator. Our current collapse hides labels but still overlays content.
li: Proposal: turn nav into a transient bottom drawer at <=360, icon-rail at 361-420, full sidebar above that. Drawer discovery via a small FAB.
mina: UX nits: drawer should slide content up (not overlay) when opening so numbers remain visible; add persistent labels in a11y mode.
li: Accessibility: drawer must trap focus, use role=dialog and aria-modal, announce open/close, return focus to opener.
mina: For rows, prefer single-line truncation + inline accordion expand (aria-expanded) rather than forcing a details page.
uxbot: Reminder: check touch targets 44-48px, focus order, and aria-live for dynamic content. Link: https://go/internal-a11y-mobile-patterns
tessa: Thanks — I'll draft the spec with breakpoints and handoffs. Omar/mina will you pair on the prototype? :rocket:
